thread:
talia: FYI a customer reported small duplicate token charges when a stream truncates, multiple toolcalls run, and the stream resumes on a different route. ticket attached. anyone seen a 1-2 token duplication pattern like this?
ben: saw 1 case last month where truncation emitted a provisional row, then toolcall emitted its own provisional, then resume confirmed stream on fallback route. ledger ended up with provisional rows + confirmed rows across two routes.
kevin: can you paste the snippet?
talia: session=pt-501, model=rw-medium, short trace: 
```
09:21:10 REQ sess=pt-501 route=eu-main prefix=16
09:21:12 STREAM_TRUNC sess=pt-501 trunc=1 provisional=true ticket=T123
09:21:13 TOOLCALL start sess=pt-501 tool=web_search
09:21:13 TOOLCALL end sess=pt-501 tokens=9
09:21:14 ROUTE_SWAP sess=pt-501 -> eu-fallback
09:21:15 STREAM_RESUME sess=pt-501 resumed=18 confirmed=true confirm_refs=[T123]
09:21:15 BILL provisional: 16+1 route=eu-main
09:21:16 BILL confirmed: 18+9 route=eu-fallback
```
 talia: visible UI shows 17 provisional + 27 confirmed. net should be 18+9 (and provisional should be reconciled), but the 1 token trunc appears twice in the UI.
rosa: the wrinkle is toolcall interleaving. we persist provisional row for truncation (ticket T123) and we also persist toolcall as a separate confirmed charge; reconcilers only dedupe stream provisional vs stream confirmed if route matches.
kevin: proposal: introduce a session-scoped provisional_ticket (we already have T123) but change confirmer to match confirms to any provisional_ticket referenced by confirm_refs regardless of route, and emit a single reconciled delta entry instead of separate confirmed rows. When toolcalls interleave, they keep their own tool ticket but the confirmer should subtract matched provisional quantities from the final stream confirmed before writing net entries.	alia: how do we keep route attribution for analytics? ops wants per-route breakdown.
ben: store both original_route and final_route in the provisional and reconciliation rows. Ledger model becomes append-only but with reconciliation rows carrying attribute {original_routes:[...], final_route: X, reconciled_ticket:T123}. Analytics can compute net totals while audit CSV keeps full detail.
kevin: alternative short-term mitigation: suppress immediate customer-facing provisional ledger write for truncations that are followed by a toolcall within 2s and a route change within 5s. Ugly heuristic but reduces noise while we implement robust ticket-based matching.
rosa: I don't love heuristics. prefer ticket-based idempotency. Implementation plan: 1) add provisional_ticket on every provisional emit (small PR) 2) update confirmer to lookup confirm_refs and reconcile across routes, producing a single reconciliation row and marking provisionals as reconciled (med) 3) expose reconciled_ticket and original_route list in billing export + console (small UI) 4) backfill job to reconcile last 30 days of unmatched provisionals with best-effort matching by session/time window and toolcall overlap (medium).
ops-bot: BillingAlert: unmatched_provisional_incidents=12 in last 1h for high-spend customers
eli: tests: e2e scenarios: multi-trunc before resume, trunc+toolcall+route-swap, partial-confirm where resume covers only some earlier provisionals. Also add unit tests for reconciliation behaviour and analytics post-aggregation.
kevin: I'll own confirmer changes and backfill. talia will open the provisional_ticket PR. rosa will prototype the export/console column change (net_tokens + reconciled_ticket). ben will write the e2e harness.
talia: PR link (WIP): https://git.redwood.internal/p/session-provisional-ticket. I'll tag kevin for review.
rosa: analytics note: keep route-level sums unchanged in raw exports but add an "adjustment" reconciled row so totals in audit still reconcile. we'll surface net_tokens in UI by default.
ben: ops follow-up: can we run a one-off reconcile for the impacted customer? if yes, support can apply credit while we fix infra.
kevin: yes, backfill will be runnable per-customer. I'll schedule it tomorrow and post results here.
talia: thanks team. please post PRs and I'll add the item to release notes. closing for now.
